card.summary: Free plan at USD 0 forever with no card required: 1,000 Smart Router requests a month, Data API at 10 requests a day, 3 tracked models and 30 days of history.

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 forever with no card required: 1,000 Smart Router requests a month, Data API at 10 requests a day, 3 tracked models and 30 days of history.

record.tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL and an aism_ router key; the Smart Router also speaks Anthropic /v1/messages
record.chaining: the 1,000 routed requests a month is the scarce link, and the caller must supply their own provider keys

limits.value: Smart Router 1,000 requests a month on Free; Data API 10 requests a day

identity_cost.detail: a free account with no card; signup is through the auth/signup page

record.reliability_note: the router bills tokens directly to the caller at the upstream list price with zero markup; a circuit opens after five straight failures and probes again after 60 seconds

evidence.proved: the free plan includes 1,000 Smart Router requests a month and 10 Data API requests a day, with no card required
evidence.quote:
- Smart Router: 1,000 requests a month
- Data API: 10 requests a day

record.notes: the free tier grants routed requests but the caller must hold OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Moonshot and Z.ai keys, so inference tokens are not free
